description: Recommend where to eat in Iași — the tool for "unde mâncăm", "where to eat", or any request for a good restaurant / place to eat. Optionally filter by cuisine, zone, vegetarian preference, or restrict to the curated editorial shortlist ("recomandarea casei"). Returns a random pick (1 by default — raise limit or call again for more). For the fixed-price daily lunch special ("meniul zilei") use find_daily_menus instead.
name: recommend_restaurants
